summary:
#### **1. Who Said What (Sort by Date & Time)**

- **[SensorKit Request] (SensorKit Review Team, Apple) – [Monday, 26 August 2024 at 19.26]:**
- Requested an updated copy of the SensorKit proposal due to issues with text boxes on the first page.
- *Key quote:* "Can you send an updated copy of your SensorKit proposal?"

- **[Camilla Michalski] (Role not specified, Happiness Research Institute) – [Monday, 26 August 2024 at 19.26]:**
- Provided an updated copy of the SensorKit proposal and additional documents.
- *Key quote:* "Please find attached the filled research proposal form to collect the specified SensorKit variables through the Mood Snapshot app."

- **[SensorKit Request] (SensorKit Review Team, Apple) – [Tuesday, 27 August 2024 at 16.41]:**
- Explained the two stages of entitlements: Development and Distribution.
- Requested agreement to the addendum and collaborator agreement.
- *Key quote:* "We approve the development entitlement pending agreement to the addendum to the SensorKit Addendum."

- **[Camilla Michalski] (Role not specified, Happiness Research Institute) – [Tuesday, 27 August 2024 at 16.41]:**
- Noted missing data types in the Addendum and provided board approval letter and consent document.
- Requested a new link to the collaborator agreement.
- *Key quote:* "Regarding the Addendum signing, our team followed the provided link and noticed that two data types are missing."

- **[SensorKit Request] (SensorKit Review Team, Apple) – [Friday, 30 August 2024 at 00.41]:**
- Clarified that the form doesn't support the newer data types but will grant all approved types.
- Provided an updated link for the collaborator agreement.
- *Key quote:* "Right now the form doesn't support those 2 data types since they are newer, but please complete the Addendum form without them."

- **[Camilla Michalski] (Role not specified, Happiness Research Institute) – [Monday, 9 September 2024 at 17.35]:**
- Confirmed signing of agreements and inquired about any outstanding items.
- *Key quote:* "We’ve signed both those agreements from our end – is there anything else outstanding at this point?"

- **[SensorKit Request] (SensorKit Review Team, Apple) – [Thursday, October 3, 2024 22:43]:**
- Followed up on the bundle ID request for the development entitlement.
- *Key quote:* "In order to grant the development entitlement we will need the bundle ID."

- **[Camilla Michalski] (Role not specified, Happiness Research Institute) – [Thursday, October 3, 2024 22:43]:**
- Provided the bundle ID for the application.
- *Key quote:* "The identifier is com.avicenna.hri3805"

- **[SensorKit Request] (SensorKit Review Team, Apple) – [Thursday, October 3, 2024 22:43]:**
- Confirmed the entitlement access to specified data streams.
- Noted the need for additional entitlement for distribution.
- *Key quote:* "Your app has just been entitled to access the following SensorKit data streams for your study."

#### **2. Timeline**
- **[26 August 2024]:** SensorKit Review Team requests updated proposal.
- **[27 August 2024]:** Development entitlement explained and addendum requested.
- **[30 August 2024]:** Clarification on data types and collaborator agreement link provided.
- **[9 September 2024]:** Agreements signed and follow-up on outstanding items.
- **[3 October 2024]:** Bundle ID provided and entitlement confirmed.

#### **3. Key Events/Issues**
- **Issue 1:** Missing data types in Addendum resolved by completing form without them.
- **Feedback Submission:** Board approval letter and consent document submitted.
- **Access/Login Issues:** Bundle ID required for development entitlement.

#### **4. Action Items**
- **Pending:**
- Distribution entitlement approval (requires IRB or ethics board approval and consent document).
- **Completed:**
- Development entitlement granted.
- Addendum and collaborator agreement signed.

#### **5. Technical Details**
- **Account/Login Info:** Bundle ID: com.avicenna.hri3805.
- **Study ID/Project Code:** App ID #6503913823.

#### **6. Next Steps**
- **Action 1:** Submit proof of IRB or ethics board approval and consent document for distribution entitlement (SensorKit Review Team).
- **Action 2:** Ensure all collaborators sign the SensorKit collaborator agreement (Camilla Michalski).
